124	def _thd_concat(
125	    ordered_tensors: list[torch.Tensor],
126	    *,
127	    dim: int,
128	    seq_lens_per_rank: list[int],
129	) -> torch.Tensor:
130	    """Per-seq concat across ranks for THD format.
131	
132	    Each rank holds segments of each seq packed contiguously:
133	      rank_data = [seq0_tokens | seq1_tokens | ... | pad_tokens]
134	
135	    This function splits each rank by seq_lens, then interleaves across ranks
136	    per-seq: [seqA_r0 + seqA_r1 + ... | seqB_r0 + seqB_r1 + ... | tail_pad].
137	    """
138	    names: tuple[Optional[str], ...] = ordered_tensors[0].names
139	    stripped: list[torch.Tensor] = [t.rename(None) for t in ordered_tensors]
140	
141	    # Split each rank into [seq0, seq1, ..., tail_remainder]
142	    split_sizes: list[int] = list(seq_lens_per_rank)
143	    remainder: int = stripped[0].shape[dim] - sum(split_sizes)
144	    if remainder < 0:
145	        raise ValueError(
146	            f"sum(seq_lens_per_rank)={sum(split_sizes)} exceeds tensor dim size "
147	            f"{stripped[0].shape[dim]} along dim={dim}"
148	        )
149	    if remainder > 0:
150	        split_sizes.append(remainder)
151	    per_rank_splits: list[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]] = [
152	        t.split(split_sizes, dim=dim) for t in stripped
153	    ]
154	
155	    # Per-seq concat across ranks, then concatenate all seqs
156	    result: torch.Tensor = torch.cat(
157	        [torch.cat(rank_parts, dim=dim) for rank_parts in zip(*per_rank_splits)],
158	        dim=dim,
159	    )
160	
161	    if names[0] is not None:
162	        result = result.refine_names(*names)
163	    return result

        t.split(split_sizes, dim=dim) for t in stripped

    result: torch.Tensor = torch.cat(
        [torch.cat(rank_parts, dim=dim) for rank_parts in zip(*per_rank_splits)],
